reviews.title: Jockny’s take
reviews.text: This is a great tool to use, to get localised information on your chosen surf site’s. I would have given it 5  out of 5  if there were more web cams in place to get live updates. I would recommend this app  to all my friends.

reviews.title: Porn Advertising
reviews.text: Advertising is often pornography- great for kids

reviews.title: Not worth the trash…
reviews.text: I used this app for the past 4+ months, or rather I tried. Every time I opened the app to check wind conditions I was assaulted by soft-porn images at the bottom of the screen. I don’t know why that’s necessary to the company but received no response to my complaint/request to have it removed. Each of my two complaints received an email response that it would be addressed with no further action. I’m aware this is a personal issue. However, if I’m unable to use an app bc I don’t know what will be shown on my phone screen it’s useless to me.

reviews.title: Windfinder
reviews.text: I’ve been using Windfinder  for 10 years and it’s been great until this year you can’t even get an accurate reading one day before you go fishing

reviews.title: No tide info?
reviews.text: “Tides” is the first word in the description here in the App Store but nowhere in the app could I find tide information for my location. If there’s some trick to finding it or if it’s only available for certain places then just say that upfront.

reviews.title: Suck
reviews.text: Windfinder says delta is 8 mph , it was 24 mph, ocean said 5 ft by 20 seconds swell, it was 7 ft by 7 seconds… SUCKS

reviews.title: Grueling
reviews.text: I got the wrong app because I just wanted wind and temperature high and low. It doesn’t give that. But Lord Almighty this is the most poorly designed app I’ve ever seen. It is grueling to use.

reviews.title: Low accuracy, low precision
reviews.text: You could almost set your watch to the time the wind would change on the app back even may be three years ago now nowadays the app is so inaccurate It’s almost worthless and right now it says the wind in my location is 13 miles an hour not even moving are barely so as my weather station says 2.1 mph
